chunks: As for what al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Jamīl ibn Darrāj, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, he said:
Touching the deceased at the time of his death and after his ghusl, and kissing him, there is no harm in it.

key_terms.غُسْلِهِ: his ghusl; the ritual washing of the deceased
key_terms.مَوْتِهِ: his death; the time of dying

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to touch or kiss a deceased person at the time of death or after ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that there is no objection to touching the deceased at the time of death or after the deceased has been given ghusl, and likewise no objection to kissing the deceased. It relates to rulings and etiquette connected to death and the handling of the body.
